features.notes: Confirmed ROOT CAUSE: TWO AILANG v0.21+ regressions, not motoko-side. (1) iface builder dropped nested function-type effect rows. (2) Lambda+match-with-pure-branch inference erases effect row to {}. Both bugs together cancelled in v0.21.0 ({}={} unifies); v0.21+ surface migration exposed both as one failure mode. Sprint plan called for escalation if upstream bug — escalated by FIXING bug 1 directly in this AILANG repo (commit 011dd490, internal/iface/builder.go + nested_effects_test.go) and source-workaround for bug 2 (top-level handle_stream_chunk extraction).
